nom: Drunk Elephant Protini Polypeptide Firming Moisturizer

avis.titre: Drunk Elephant Protini Peptide Firming Moisturizer
avis.texte: This is the Best moisturizer hands down. I am 66 yo and have using this for abt 3 years. Now and then I try something else and Always come back to this. When I wake up in the morning, my face feels and looks wonderful. Nothing compares. Plus, I love the refill.

I discovered Drunk Elephant a few years ago and have tried all of their moisturizers to see which one I liked the best. I keep coming back to the Protini Polypeptide Firming moisturizer because of its thickness. I find it to be a great in-between thickness that is neither too thin nor too thick. In fact, I wear this under my makeup and it doesn't cause pilling or splotchy coverage. I know some people say the price is too high, but since it is one of the only moisturizers that is calming for my sensitive rosacea skin AND hydrating my skin, I find the price point to be better than other moisturizers that claim to be made specifically for rosacea skin

avis.titre: Great for older skin and rosacea
avis.texte: Drunk Elephant Portini Polypeptide Cream has become my Holy Grail of moisturizer. I am over 40, so I've tried many moisturizers to address the needs of aging skin. This moisturizer gave me exactly what I need. Also, I have rosacea, so it's important that I use a moisturizer that doesn't irritate or flare my skin. I've noticed improvement in the redness since using Protini.
I love this! It smooths out your skin really well and I'm 70!

I've used this cream for years without any issues. I am acne prone skin and this moisturizer was perfect, not until november of last year, the formulation was changed and started to get a lot of neck acne with white heads around the forehead. I wish they kept the old formula!

This is the only product that works for my extremely sensitive skin. I'm allergic to everything and have rosacea. This moisturizer calms my skin and does not clog my pores. I only wish it was less expensive
I like the texture of the moisturizer itself but was pretty disappointed it came half full for the price it is. Probably wouldn't waste my money again
The cream is too expensive for the amount you get and my face somehow felt drier after using it

I did a lot of research to find a really strong cream-based moisturizer for my aging skin. I'm 50 going through menopause so my skin is changing dramatically. I bought this after hearing, reading and seeing positive results. Well, it didn't work at all for me. My skin was dry and even flaky after using it for a week. I wish that I wouldn't have bought sick a big size.

I was reluctant to buy drunk elephant at first because of the price. Curiosity won me over and i bought the travel set. I love this moisturizer! I have already restocked this in the fullsize! It is worth the price. My skin is hydrated, and clear!
I have used Protini Polypeptide for a couple of years and my skin is smoother and more lifted. I have rosacea and this product is wonderful for sensitive skin!
Love this product. Noticed a difference in the hydration of my skin. My skin is definitely smoother.

I've gone through at least 5 regular containers and 2-3 minis in the last four years. It has become a go to product. It feels moisturizing even when I use strong cleansers, and I feel it improves the texture of my skin.

I have been using for over 5 years. I have tried a few other brands, but always come back to this one. I have senstive skin and this is one of the only mositruizers that has worked for me. My one complaint is with the refills. I have had issues with fit and functioning of the original container. After replacing lotion, the dispenser stopped working.

avis.titre: Feels Great On My Skin, But Not Seeing Other Results
avis.texte: I have been using this for a little over a month now. The PROS… It feels amazing on my skin. My skin feels silky, soft and it feels incredibly hydrated. It also wears very well underneath makeup. The CONS… it advertises that it helps with the appearance of skin tone, texture, and firmness. I have not noticed any difference in any of thsoe areas. CONCLUSION … if you're looking for a hydrating moisturizer that feels wonderful on your skin and works well with sensitive skin, this is a wonderful moisturizer for you. If you're looking for the benefits of improved tone, texture, and firmness, like it advertises, I would not recommend this moistureizer.

USE WITH CAUTION! I recently ordered a new one late October. For reference my last Protini was purchased July 2025. I have no idea what happened but within hours of application my face became red, I woke up the next day and had small milia/whiteheads, all over my face and neck along with a lovely rash. Stopped using it immediately, reached out to the company to confirm any formula changes, to which they said there was none. Returned the product but am still wondering what happened as I have been using this particular cream for years and never had an issue. If you plan to start using this cream or even get a new one, start using it when you have no important events coming up, just in case you have a reaction.

avis.titre: Nice product but packaging poor. Dries out - does not pump!
avis.texte: Love the product. Especially for my eyes but the pump jar did not work and allowed air to enter in a dry out/ evaporate the product. Also hard to pump from the jar as well. Had to unscrew top to get cream out!
Drunk elephant has the best products. This one is my favorite.

I have very oily acne probe skin. I dont use any moisturizers on my face cuz i usually break out. Im 38 about to be 39. I saw the reviews and decided to buy it. It is expensive but i truly have to say its worth the price. I been using it for about 3/4 months now. I was using it consistantly the first month at night but i noticed maybe 1 day out of the week I was waking up with a tiny white head. I use it a few times a week now. I actually like using it in the morning before i put my makeup on. My daughter whos 13 I caught using it and I laughed but she actually loves it haha .. i did notice the pump after a while wouldn't pump the cream out so i had to keep pumping and it started working fine adtwr that. A little goes a long way. My skin does feel a lil irritated if i clunk it on but if i put just the right anount its fine. Like i said, my skin is very sensitive. Its smooth, smells pleasant , lightweight and very moisturizing. I personally will continue to buy it. The peice is outrageous but you pay for what u get.

I bought this for the first time in 2023 (a smaller size). This moisturizer makes my skin feel hydrated without being greasy. It's very lightweight - this is a great moisturizer for folks with oily, combo, or normal skin. I have continued to repurchase this since and have gone through 4 of the 3.3oz size and 1 of the larger size they sell around the holidays. I have used similar moisturizers / dupes and haven't found anything that compares to it. Love the Protini Polypeptide Moisturizer! I'm not a fan of most other DE products, but this one is A++++.

I got this moisturizer and I heard amazing reviews about it. I got it while being indesicive on its price, but still got it to treat myself on my birthday. After about 1-2 uses I broke out so bad! Weird because I never ever break out. My skin is usually amazing and fine with products. This broke me out so bad to the point I was crying so hard to even move my face! I would never even think about buying again and would NOT recommend getting it. And my skin is a mixture of oily and dry. Although, I have tried other products from Drunk Elephant and they have been fine, so I guess this moisturizer just doesn't work for me. 🤷‍♀️

I needed an oil-free, cruelty-free moisturizer to replace my discontinued holy grail by another brand. After trying a couple different brands that did not work out, I took a chance on this one. I am pleasantly surprised by the results! It is not greasy, and it verges on a matte finish without hitting that overdry consistency. It does not cause my skin to go into overproduction of oil like others. It goes on nice and smooth and absorbs evenly. Some people may dislike the smell of this lotion--to me, it smells vaguely like wheat, and that is okay with me. This product is a little on the expensive side, that is its only downfall.
This is the perfect light weight moisturizer. I use this in the morning most days and mix it with the bronzing drops!
Love this! Ive gotten some in the past and when I ran out I tried a couple dupes but nothing compares! Only thing to keep my skin hydrated and not flakey.

I love this product and I have used it for a few years now. I always get the largest size since I use it daily. PLEASE SELL THE 100ML REFILLS! I feel so wasteful buying the full outer-packaging every time I need to refill. I know I could do auto-replenish, but I prefer to not have subscriptions looming over me/ it varies how often I need to replenish. HELP :)

avis.titre: Best packaging for the best moisturizer
avis.texte: I use this product every morning and sometimes at night. I love the feel of the moisturizer and I love the packaging! It is so nice to pop up exactly as much as I need rather than wasting excess product.
Been using Drunk Elephant products for years and love the results. I would like to see reduced packaging and more refillable items. So much plastic and cardboard with each item......

avis.titre: Doesn't work with the 100 ml container
avis.texte: The product is the same great cream we all love! But I was disappointed in the refill aspect. I have the 100ml container. I searched high and low to see if this refill was compatible with the larger container. I didn't find ANY information so I ordered it and hoped for the best. Turns out it doesn't pump. I'm still using it by dipping in because I do love it! But I am bummed that there wasn't info on it not fitting the larger container (or the option for a larger refill).

avis.titre: Yes, I would buy this again
avis.texte: I like this moisturizer because it very light, and easy to apply from the bottle-no lids to hunt for and my skin remains soft for hours.

I've tried a lot of Drunk Elephant products (I love them all), but this one is by far my favorite! I love the texture, I love how it makes my skin feel, and I especially love that their products aren't loaded with fragrances. I've noticed my skin is looking smoother/less wrinkly, and less prone to blemishes. I also have a lot of hyperpigmentation and it's definitely less noticeable.

I've used this cream for years without any issues. I am acne prone skin and this moisturizer was perfect, not until november of last year, the formulation was changed and started to get a lot of neck acne with white heads around the forehead. I wish they kept the old formula!

This made my husband finally love my feet again. He says they are so soft and supple. #loveyourhubby. #drunksupplefeettttt. MY hubby thinks they should make a toe cream next.
I like the texture of the moisturizer itself but was pretty disappointed it came half full for the price it is. Probably wouldn't waste my money again
The cream is too expensive for the amount you get and my face somehow felt drier after using it
I absolutely love this. I love the packaging. I love the way it feels the dispense is a little tricky but overall I'm a big fan!

avis.titre: This product makes a difference and I'll continue to buy it.
avis.texte: I use this cream every night before bed and every morning on my face and neck. I've been using it for a year or so and I can really tell the difference. My skin seems clearer and smoother, especially my neck which used to have that chicken neck crepey look.

I have been waiting to buy this since trying a sample size some time ago. I love Drunk Elephant products, and I think having the ones I bought in Jan has improved my overall skin tone and appearance. I am excited to have them all, and for the first time,e I feel I have a real morning and evening routine that is paying off.

I love the dispenser, I love the company as a whole, but unfortunately this moisturizer is just not moisturizing at all. It's mostly a peptide treatment, definitely not a fully functional moisturizer. I paid a lot of money for it so I'm using it in conjunction with a moisturizer but I won't reorder.

I mix with my Tretinoin & Hydroquinone every night. During the day I use it alone with SPF. I have acne/oily skin & this is amazing! It doesn't cause more breakouts. My skin is visibly smoother.

It moisturizes moderately well, but not super well, to be honest. If you have dry skin you may want to go to the Lala retro cream instead. I do like the protini for it's non-comedogenic properties…it does not cause me to break out and does not clog my pores. However it has such an extreme matte look that my face does not even look moisturized. It's extremely matte which is really disappointing because although I don't prefer the "glass look" I do prefer a tiny bit of shine so my skin looks healthy, moisturized, and bouncy.

I was reluctant to buy drunk elephant at first because of the price. Curiosity won me over and i bought the travel set. I love this moisturizer! I have already restocked this in the fullsize! It is worth the price. My skin is hydrated, and clear!

avis.titre: I buy this moisturizer travel and home sizes regularly.

avis.titre: Great day cream for normal to dry skin.

So far so good. Hard to review something when you just got it.

avis.titre: Great product but beware of sale tactics
avis.texte: I love the product, but feel I was tricked. The website said it was the biggest sale of the year and then it went on a bigger sale the following week.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: My skin is very sensitive and this is my favorite moisturizer. It's very lightweight and doesn't leave behind any oil or excess. My skin feels soft after using it, and it doesn't leave any residue behind. Also doesn't cause me to break which is another plus. It's the only moisturizer I like.

This is one of the very few moisturizers that doesn't cause my very sensitive rosacia skin to react. There is no noticeable scent or highly active ingredients. For me, Protini is a gentle and neutral moisturizer with a medium to light creamy texture that provides a medium level of moisture. I've used this for years and it's my go-to moisturizer. In the warm months I used it exclusively, but in the winter when it is icy cold out, I may also add the Lala Retro Whipped moisturizer to the cheek area at night.
Love this super moisturizer especially in the winter. Love it!!

avis.titre: The only moisturizer that does what it is supposed to!
avis.texte: Great Moisturizer. It doesn't cause any acne. It is also great for looking younger. It does all this while feeling normal (non greasy) on the skin. It's the only moisturizer I will buy.
I use this under my make up daily and it unfortunately doesn't seem to give me enough moisturizer all day.

I've started using it as a smoothie with vitamin c and b hdyra in the morning and it works great for me. I love how you can buy refills for it too, which I'll definitely do once mine is empty.

avis.titre: Product is 10/10. Customer Service is a challenge ...
avis.texte: This is my 2nd purchase at DE. Ironically I have an open issue as the dispenser top has failed and the refill leaked out all over my hands and countertop. I have requested a replacement. Customer service asked for all my info a week ago and I have yet to get a response. Chat wait is over 2 hours, phone hold is even longer....only hope is email and it's not going great. Honestly, I'm going back to the counter The refill arrived as expected. The products is 10/10, the most lovely face cream I have tried. The dispenser pump of my original bottle/original purchase has failed. I am sticking my finger into a pot of cream - not the top tier experience. I provided proof of both of my purchases, I hope DE replaces the broken item. Otherwise, Clinique is going to get my business. The counter girls would never let me live without a pump. Please contact me to make it right and aid love to edit this review to reflect a positive customer service/replacement experience. The DE products are lovely! The customer service, so far, is lacking in a big way.
The product itself is great but the refillable container is terrible quality it broke and it does not work
I love this product. I have used for years. Perfect consistency. Works amazing.

avis.titre: This is the only moisturizer I will ever use!

avis.titre: One of my go to products that I use every day and recommend

If I ever by accident forget this traveling it's extremely noticeable that I can not wait to get home and wash my face just to have my skin feeling better. I'm 33, and get told all the time my skin is amazing and I like to think this has a lot to do with it. Yes it's worth every penny to start using this in your mid to late 20's to keep your skin looking youthful. One jar will have you hooked. Avid use for years will have your skin staying young.

avis.titre: This is a critical element of my skin care
avis.texte: I have been using Protini since it came out. It is perfect for my maturing skin. I have compared the Protini ingredients to medical grade brands and Protini beats them all for my skin. It has just the right amount of daily hydration - absorbs quickly - isn't sticky or greasy - it feels wonderful on the skin and doesn't make makeup pill. The value size is a bonus. The container is perfect - it dispenses a single shot and prevents contamination found in other products that are in a jar. It a perfect product and I love it.
This has been my go-to since 2018. It doesn't feel heavy, but has the perfect consistency for my acne prone skin. This is also the perfect base for my NARS foundation even without a primer.

I have been using this moisturizer for a couple years now. I use it year round: in fall/winter as my daytime moisturizer and in spring/summer as my nighttime moisturizer. It goes on so smooth and does keep my 41-year-old natural face looking great! I especially love being able to buy a refill. Highly recommend.
i LOVE THE POLY PEPETIDE CREAM, BUT THOUGHT I WOULD TRY TO RECYCLE BY BUYING THE REFILL. UNFORTUNATELY THE CONTAINER WILL NOT PUMP. I WONT BUY THE REFILL AGAIN
added this moisturizer to my skincare, after 2 50 ml jars i realized this was the product that completely ruined my skin. Once i cut this out of my routine my skin went back to normal.

avis.titre: Thank goodness for the jumbo size

I use this daily with the serums, Marula Oil and my skin looks amazing.

Love this Drunken Elephant product! It's the only moisturizer I use at bedtime that hasn't given me a rash. I have allergies and sensitive skin but this product works. Keeps my skin moist but not oily.
